We have $3^{2k}$ indistinguishable coins, one counterfeit (lighter). Three two-pan balances, one is faulty (gives random readings), the other two are accurate but we don't know which is which. We need to identify the counterfeit in at most $3k+1$ weighings.

But the challenge is the faulty scale. One of three scales is faulty (random). We don't know which.
